description: Creates a subscriber (identity, optional service address, and optionally a plan; attach a gateway host separately). Always returns 201 — there is no external-reference deduplication. subscriberNumber is the only required field. Requires scope create:subscribers.

requestBody.name: subscriberNumber
requestBody.description: The operator-supplied external reference. Required; 1-32 characters.

requestBody.name: name
requestBody.description: Optional display name for the subscriber (e.g. the customer or account name shown in your CRM). The 128 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: email
requestBody.description: The 255 limit is bytes of UTF-8.

requestBody.name: notes
requestBody.description: The 4096 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: serviceAddress
requestBody.description: Free-text service address. The 1024 limit is bytes of UTF-8, so multi-byte characters each count as more than one.

requestBody.name: planId
requestBody.description: Optionally assign a plan at create time.

requestBody.name: metadata
requestBody.description: Free-form key/value metadata. The serialized JSON object must not exceed 8192 bytes (8 KiB); a larger object is rejected with 400.

children.name: serviceAddress
children.description: Omitted from the response entirely when not set (never returned as JSON null).

children.name: suspendReason
children.description: Present only while suspended; omitted (not null) otherwise.

children.name: suspendedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) when the subscriber has never been suspended.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Omitted (not null) when no metadata is set.

children.name: activatedAt
children.description: Omitted (not null) until the subscriber's first host attach.

remote.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = json.dumps({
  "subscriberNumber": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "notes": "string",
  "serviceAddress": "string",
  "planId": "string",
  "metadata": {}
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("POST", "/v1/carrier/subscribers", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
